title: MXR triangular inversion for Qwen3.6 on Ascend

paper.title: Fast and Stable Triangular Inversion for Delta-Rule Linear Transformers

objective: Reproduce the official MXR/PTO mechanism faithfully on Ascend, prove multi-step numerical correctness and target-shape advantage, then obtain attributable matched end-to-end performance without quality regression through a plugin-owned monkeypatch.

timebox.policy: one continuous wall-clock window; no pause or reset
timebox.deadline_rule: Push a scoped terminal checkpoint by the deadline. Environment failure does not become an MXR failure and does not extend the slot.

goal_alignment.long_term: Deliver reproducible and portable Ascend performance benefit through a plugin-owned implementation without modifying upstream frameworks or images.
goal_alignment.medium_term: Build a complete evidence chain: official-method parity, CANN 9.1 compatibility, NPU numerical correctness, target-shape kernel timing, matched dense end-to-end A/B, and final quality.
goal_alignment.short_term: By 2026-09-20T19:52:15Z, either pass the shared NPU canary and execute the prepared one-shot NPU4 numerical and target-shape timing gate, or push an environment-inconclusive terminal checkpoint without touching physical NPU0-3.

fixed_gates.stop_rule: Stop heavy integration and advance to the next portfolio item, DeltaLog, if the candidate has no clear target-shape kernel advantage, the attributable end-to-end gain is expected to remain below about 5 percent, or the hard deadline is reached.
